take.title_zh: AI 帳單到期，採用回歸現實
take.body_zh:
本期新聞指向同一件事：AI 正從「盡量用」走向「算清楚」。Apple 傳出削減內部 AI 預算，tokenmaxxing 退燒；Uber 上季最忙的一週只有 4 人用 AI 代理叫車；AI PAC 砸錢影響期中選舉，成效也好壞參半。

同時，基礎建設投資沒有停：Dropbox 以 3.5 億美元收購 Tigris Data，為 AI 代理打造儲存平台。對設計師與 PM 來說，重點已不是「加上 AI」，而是證明它真的省下步驟，而且所有人都能用。
take.body_en:
This issue's stories point the same way: AI is shifting from "use as much as possible" to "show me the return." Apple is reportedly cutting internal AI budgets as tokenmaxxing cools, Uber says only four people used agents to book rides in its busiest week last quarter, and AI PACs saw mixed results in the midterms.

Infrastructure spending hasn't slowed: Dropbox is paying $350 million for Tigris Data to build storage for agents. For designers and PMs, the job is no longer adding AI. It's proving that AI removes real steps and works for everyone.

articles.title_zh: AI 政治行動委員會砸數百萬美元影響期中選舉，成效好壞參半
articles.title_en: AI PACs Spent Millions to Shape Congress, With Mixed Results
articles.summary_zh: 2026 美國期中選舉剛落幕，TechCrunch 盤點 AI 產業政治行動委員會（PAC）的表現：這些團體投入數百萬美元，試圖影響國會席次，進而左右 AI 監管走向，但結果有勝有負，並未形成一面倒的影響力。相關團體已開始布局下一個選舉週期，顯示 AI 業者把政治投入視為長期戰略，而非一次性動作。
articles.summary_en: With the 2026 US midterms just wrapped, TechCrunch tallied how the AI industry's political action committees performed. The groups spent millions trying to shape who sits in Congress, and by extension how AI gets regulated, but the results were mixed rather than a clean sweep. The PACs are already turning their attention to the next election cycle, a sign that the industry treats political spending as a long-term play rather than a one-off.
articles.take_zh: 監管走向最終會決定 AI 產品能做什麼、必須揭露什麼。設計師與 PM 不必追每一場選舉，但值得留意透明度、隱私與責任歸屬相關法規，提早把合規需求放進產品規劃。
articles.take_en: Regulation will ultimately define what AI products can do and what they must disclose. You don't need to track every race, but keep an eye on rules around transparency, privacy, and accountability, and build compliance into roadmaps early.

articles.title_zh: 傳 Apple 削減內部 AI 使用預算，tokenmaxxing 熱潮降溫
articles.title_en: Apple Reportedly Cuts Budgets for Internal AI Usage
articles.summary_zh: 據報導，Apple 正在削減員工內部使用 AI 工具的預算。TechCrunch 指出，過去企業鼓勵員工盡量多用 AI、大量消耗 token 的「tokenmaxxing」風潮，在帳單陸續到期後迅速冷卻，越來越多公司開始考慮為 token 用量設上限。這反映企業採購 AI 的心態，正從「先用再說」轉向計算投資報酬率。
articles.summary_en: Apple is reportedly trimming budgets for employees' internal AI usage. According to TechCrunch, the "tokenmaxxing" craze, in which companies pushed staff to use AI as much as possible regardless of token costs, is cooling fast now that the bills have come due. More companies are weighing caps on token consumption. It signals a shift in enterprise AI buying from "use it everywhere" to hard questions about return on investment.
articles.take_zh: AI 工具不再是無限暢飲。團隊若依賴付費 AI 席次或額度，應開始記錄哪些流程真的省時，用數據為預算辯護，而不是等額度被砍才被迫調整工作方式。
articles.take_en: AI tools are no longer an open bar. If your team leans on paid AI seats or credits, start tracking which workflows actually save time. You'll want data to defend the budget before someone else decides where to cut.

articles.title_zh: Uber：上季最忙的一週，只有 4 個人用 AI 代理叫車
articles.title_en: Almost No One Uses AI Agents to Book an Uber, Company Says
articles.summary_zh: Uber 透露，在上一季最忙碌的一週裡，只有四位使用者透過 AI 代理（AI agents）預約乘車。儘管科技公司大力推動「讓代理替你完成任務」的願景，這個數字顯示，至少在叫車這類日常、即時的消費情境中，使用者仍習慣自己打開 App 操作，代理式預訂的實際採用率遠低於業界宣傳。
articles.summary_en: Uber says that during the busiest week of last quarter, exactly four people used AI agents to book a ride. For all the industry talk about agents handling everyday tasks on our behalf, the figure suggests that in quick, routine consumer scenarios like hailing a car, people still prefer to open the app and tap through it themselves. Real-world adoption of agent-driven booking lags far behind the hype.
articles.take_zh: 這是代理式體驗最好的現實提醒：使用者已有順手的介面時，代理很難帶來足夠增益。設計 agent 功能前，先釐清它替使用者省掉哪些步驟，而不是只因為技術做得到。
articles.take_en: A useful reality check for agentic UX: when users already have a fast, familiar interface, an agent has to clear a high bar to add value. Before building agent features, define exactly which steps they remove, not just what's technically possible.

articles.title_zh: 讓沉浸式 LLM 聊天介面更具無障礙性
articles.title_en: Making Immersive LLM Chat Experiences More Accessible
articles.summary_zh: LLM 聊天介面已成產品標配，Eric Bailey 在 Smashing Magazine 分享他改善這類介面的實戰經驗，提供讓網頁聊天體驗更適合輔助科技（如螢幕閱讀器）使用者的具體做法。核心論點是：聊天介面承載越來越多資訊、工具與機會，若無法被所有人使用，就等於把一部分使用者擋在門外。
articles.summary_en: LLM chat interfaces are becoming a default part of products, and Eric Bailey's piece for Smashing Magazine argues they need to work for everyone. Drawing on his own experience improving these interfaces, he shares practical techniques for making web-based chat experiences more usable for people who rely on assistive technology. The stakes are high: as chat UIs become gateways to information, tools, and opportunities, inaccessible ones lock people out.
articles.take_zh: 串流輸出、動態更新的訊息、不斷變長的對話，都是螢幕閱讀器的難題。正在做 AI 聊天功能的團隊，可以把這篇當成上線前的檢查清單，把無障礙測試排進計畫。
articles.take_en: Streaming responses, live-updating messages, and ever-growing threads are tough for screen readers. If your team is shipping an AI chat feature, treat this as a pre-launch checklist and put accessibility testing in the plan, not the backlog.

articles.title_zh: 現代 CSS 可能讓你的前端變得更複雜
articles.title_en: Modern CSS Might Make Your Front-End More Complex
articles.summary_zh: 用現代 CSS 取代 JavaScript，常被視為精簡程式碼的好方法。但 Gabriel Shoyombo 在 Smashing Magazine 指出，單一段程式碼變簡單，不代表整個應用更好理解：當邏輯被拆散在 CSS 與 JavaScript 之間，追蹤狀態與除錯反而更困難。文章也提供遷移過程中控制複雜度的實用建議。
articles.summary_en: Swapping JavaScript for modern CSS features is often pitched as a way to simplify code. In Smashing Magazine, Gabriel Shoyombo pushes back: a single snippet may get simpler while the overall app gets harder to reason about. When logic is split between CSS and JavaScript, tracking state and debugging become trickier. He closes with practical advice for keeping complexity in check during a migration.
articles.take_zh: 對與工程協作的設計師來說，這是很好的提醒：互動效果放在哪一層實作，會影響後續維護成本。提出新動效或狀態樣式時，不妨一起確認邏輯的單一來源在哪裡。
articles.take_en: For designers who work closely with engineers, this is a useful lens: where an interaction lives in the stack affects how hard it is to maintain. When proposing new motion or state styles, ask where the single source of truth for that logic will be.

articles.title_zh: Dropbox 以 3.5 億美元收購 Tigris Data，強化 AI 基礎設施
articles.title_en: Dropbox Acquires Tigris Data for $350M to Bolster AI Infrastructure
articles.summary_zh: Dropbox 宣布以 3.5 億美元收購 Tigris Data，強化自家 AI 基礎設施。這筆交易預計將用於打造名為 DBX Agent Cloud 的全新儲存平台，鎖定開發 AI 模型與 AI 代理的開發者。以檔案同步與團隊協作起家的 Dropbox，正試圖把定位從生產力工具延伸為 AI 時代的資料底層。
articles.summary_en: Dropbox is acquiring Tigris Data for $350 million to bolster its AI infrastructure. The deal is expected to power DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform aimed at developers building AI models and agents. Best known for file sync and team collaboration, Dropbox is trying to stretch its positioning from productivity tool to data layer for the AI era, competing for a slice of agent workloads.
articles.take_zh: 當 AI 代理需要大量讀取與操作檔案，儲存就不只是「放檔案的地方」。設計師常用的協作工具正悄悄變成代理的資料來源，檔案結構與權限設計會比以往更重要。
articles.take_en: As agents need to read and act on large volumes of files, storage stops being just a place to park assets. The collaboration tools designers rely on are quietly becoming data sources for agents, so file structure and permissions will matter more than ever.

articles.title_zh: Instagram 推出 Edits 桌面版，正面挑戰 CapCut
articles.title_en: Instagram Brings Edits to Desktop to Take On CapCut
articles.summary_zh: Meta 旗下影片剪輯 App Edits 推出桌面版，與字節跳動的 CapCut 正面競爭。Edits 原本就是 Meta 去年為對抗 CapCut 而推出的行動剪輯工具，這次登上桌面，等於把戰場從手機延伸到創作者的完整工作流程，鎖定需要更大螢幕、更精細剪輯的創作者與社群團隊。
articles.summary_en: Meta's video editing app Edits is coming to desktop, setting up a more direct fight with ByteDance's CapCut. Meta launched Edits last year specifically to challenge CapCut on mobile; the desktop version extends that battle into creators' full workflow, targeting creators and social teams who want a bigger screen and finer editing control. It's another sign that short-form video tools are maturing from quick phone edits into serious production software.
articles.take_zh: 社群影音工具正從手機延伸到桌面，跨裝置的連續性成為關鍵體驗。做品牌社群素材的設計師，可比較 Edits 與 CapCut 的模板、字幕與輸出流程，再決定團隊工作流。
articles.take_en: Social video tooling is moving beyond the phone, and cross-device continuity is becoming the core experience. Designers producing brand content should compare Edits and CapCut on templates, captions, and export workflows before standardizing on one.

articles.title_zh: ElevenLabs 開放將 AI 生成音樂直接發布到 SoundCloud
articles.title_en: ElevenLabs Lets Users Publish AI-Generated Music Directly on SoundCloud
articles.summary_zh: AI 語音與音訊公司 ElevenLabs 宣布，使用者現在可以把用其音樂模型生成的作品直接發布到 SoundCloud。ElevenLabs 表示，其音樂模型至今已生成超過 2,500 萬首曲目。這項串接讓 AI 生成內容從工具內的實驗，直接進入公開的音樂發布平台，大幅縮短從生成到被聽見的距離。
articles.summary_en: ElevenLabs now lets users publish music made with its AI model directly to SoundCloud. The company says its music model has already generated more than 25 million tracks. The integration moves AI-generated audio out of the creation tool and straight onto a public distribution platform, shrinking the gap between generating a track and putting it in front of real listeners.
articles.take_zh: 生成工具開始直接串接發布平台，「創作到發布」的距離越來越短。接下來各平台都得面對的設計題目，是如何清楚標示 AI 參與程度與授權來源。
articles.take_en: Generative tools are plugging straight into distribution, collapsing the distance between making and publishing. Next up for every platform: interfaces that clearly label how much AI was involved and where rights come from, a design problem as much as a policy one.
